arxiv-1809-08664.title: Computing with P Systems Thanks: An slightly updated version of A. Syropoulos, S. Doumanis, K.T. Sotiriades, Computing Recursive Functions with P Systems, Pre-proceedings of the Fifth Workshop on Membrane Computing (WMC5), Milano, Italy, June 2004, pp. 414–421.
arxiv-1809-08664.creator: Apostolos Syropoulos, Stratos Doumanis, Konstantinos T. Sotiriades
arxiv-1809-08664.description: Abstract P systems are computing conceptual computing devices that are at least as powerful as Turing machines. However, until recently it was not known how one can encode any recursive function as a P system. Here we propose a new encoding of recursive as P systems with graph-like structure, which is the main difference with previous documented attempts.

arxiv-2106-14648.title: On Locality of Local Explanation Models
arxiv-2106-14648.creator: Sahra GhalebikesabiUniversity of Oxford sahra.ghalebikesabi@stats.ox.ac.uk, Lucile Ter-MinassianUniversity of Oxford lucile.ter-minassian@stats.ox.ac.uk Karla Diaz-OrdazThe London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine & The Alan Turing InstituteChris HolmesUniversity of Oxford & The Alan Turing Inst
arxiv-2106-14648.description: Abstract Shapley values provide model agnostic feature attributions for model outcome at a particular instance by simulating feature absence under a global population distribution. The use of a global population can lead to potentially misleading results when local model behaviour is of interest. Hence we consider the formulation of neighbourhood reference distributions that improve the local interpretability of Shapley values.

arxiv-2309-09016.title: Solitons and Normal Random Matrices
arxiv-2309-09016.description: Abstract We discuss a general relation between the solitons and statistical mechanics and show that the partition function of the normal random matrix model can be obtained from the multi-soliton solutions of the two-dimensional Toda lattice hierarchy in a special limit. arxiv-2310-11918.title: Interferometric sorting of temporal Hermite-Gauss modes via temporal Gouy phase
arxiv-2310-11918.creator: Dmitri B. Horoshko, Mikhail I. Kolobov
arxiv-2310-11918.description: Abstract We propose a device consisting of m m Mach-Zehnder interferometers and realizing sorting of first 2 m 2^{m} temporal Hermite-Gauss modes of light passing through it by adjusting the accumulated temporal Gouy phase acquired by every mode. This mode-order-dependent phase shift is achieved by a fractional Fourier transform realized by a time lens in one of the interferometer’s arms.

arxiv-2412-10376.title: Estimations of Fourier Coefficients For Controlled Distortion of a Periodic Function.
arxiv-2412-10376.creator: Vladimir Sluchak
arxiv-2412-10376.description: Abstract There is a class of physical filtration processes where the input is adequately modeled by a continuous periodic function f (x) of bounded variation over its period, and the output depends only on certain harmonics of the Fourier expansion of f (x) in the orthogonal basis of trigonometric functions.

arxiv-2412-18747.title: Orbital Collapse in Exotic Atoms and Its Effect on Dynamics
arxiv-2412-18747.creator: X. M. Tong, K. Tőkési, D. Kato, T. Okumura, S. Okada, T. Azuma
arxiv-2412-18747.description: Abstract We study the energy structures of muonic Ar atoms and find the muon orbital collapses at a critical angular momentum l c l_{c} using density-functional theory (DFT). The l c l_{c} may provide an upper limit for the muon-captured states in muon-Ar collisions.

arxiv-2504-07291.title: NFL Draft Modelling: Loss Functional Analysis
arxiv-2504-07291.creator: Tanmay Grandhisiri
arxiv-2504-07291.description: Abstract In the NFL draft, teams must strategically balance immediate player impact against long-term value, presenting a complex optimization challenge for draft capital management. This paper introduces a framework for evaluating the fairness and efficiency of draft pick trades using norm-based loss functions. Draft pick valuations are modelled by the Weibull distribution.

arxiv-2508-00827.title: A Foundational Schema.org Mapping for a Legal Knowledge Graph: Representing Brazilian Legal Norms as FRBR Works
arxiv-2508-00827.creator: Hudson de Martim
arxiv-2508-00827.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hudson de Martim. Structuring legal norms for machine readability is a critical prerequisite for building advanced AI and information retrieval systems, such as Legal Knowledge Graphs (LKGs). Grounded in the Functional Requirements for Bibliographic Records (FRBR) model, this paper proposes a foundational mapping for the abstract legal Work —which is materialized as the Norm node in our legal Graph RAG framework [ 1 ] —to the interoperable schema.org/Legislation vocabulary.

pmc-10746461.title: Multilayer amnion-PCL nanofibrous membrane loaded with celecoxib exerts a therapeutic effect against tendon adhesion by improving the inflammatory microenvironment
pmc-10746461.creator: Chunjie Liu, Xiaochong Zhang, Lili Zhao, Limin Hui, Dengxiang Liu
pmc-10746461.description: Tendon adhesion is a common complication after tendon surgery. The inflammatory phase of tendon healing is characterized by the release of a large number of inflammatory factors, whose mediated excessive inflammatory response is an important cause of tendon adhesion formation. Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs(NSAIDs) were used to prevent tendon adhesions by reducing the inflammatory response.

pmc-11664140.title: Global, regional, and national burden of acute lymphoblastic leukemia in children: Epidemiological trends analysis from 1990 to 2021
pmc-11664140.creator: Yuyuan Hu, Yongping Liu, Jieting Fu, Yong Liu, Haiying Wang, Ying Song
pmc-11664140.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryChildren are the main susceptible group to acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), and the lack of sufficient data has impeded a comprehensive understanding of its global impact. This study analyzed the annual numbers and rates of incidence, deaths, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) of childhood ALL from 1990 to 2021, disaggregated by age group, gender, and socio-demographic index (SDI) at the global, regional, and national levels, based on the 2021 Global Burden of Disease (GBD) database.

pmc-12648581.title: Beta-cyclodextrin inclusion complexes of citral and linalool inhibit Escherichia coli on cooked chicken: Focus on their synergistic antibacterial effects
pmc-12648581.creator: Wanying Zhu, Yuhe Dong, Tong Wu, Haohan Jing, Zikai Li, Xi Yu, Ying Xiao, Tian Zhong
pmc-12648581.description: Citral and linalool are two well-studied antibacterial essential oil compounds. However, their synergistic antibacterial effects have not been fully elucidated. This study explored their synergistic mechanism against Escherichia coli and the potential of their β-cyclodextrin (β-CD) inclusion complexes in food preservation.

pmc-12822284.title: 2b-RAD sequencing of Malus florentina populations reveals strong population structure and signals of balancing selection at disease resistance loci
pmc-12822284.creator: David Papp, Viktor Papp, Csaba Kozma, Sadia Tabassum Tanni, Fabio Conti, Tamás Deák, Zoltán Barina
pmc-12822284.description: BackgroundCrop wild relatives of Malus domestica represent exceptional value as breeding resources and ornamental trees, nonetheless their natural populations are under threat due to anthropogenic factors. Malus florentina is an apple species endemic to the Balkans and Italy, and our current knowledge on its population genetics and conservation biological status is strongly limited.

pmc-13079494.title: A new multi-residue method for PFAS analysis in wastewater for environmental and public health risk assessment

pmc-13554849.title: Case report for an intervention for scientific pressure by brief strategic withdrawal
pmc-13554849.creator: Lin Meng, Shiqi Wu, Zhen Wu
pmc-13554849.description: Background and aimsWith the increasing number of postgraduates being admitted, the scientific and academic pressure faced by this group is becoming more obvious, causing more concerns among people in tertiary education. This study is an exploratory, context-rich single-case report. This research aims at supplement the research deficiency in releasing pressure related to academic pressure.

pmc-13612842.title: Theta and Gamma Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (tACS) Modulate Mandarin Consonant and Lexical Tone Perception
pmc-13612842.creator: Yaxuan Wang, Keke Yu, Shuqi Yin, Baishen Liang, Ruiming Wang
pmc-13612842.description: A theta/gamma neural activity mechanism has been postulated to explain the auditory sampling of hierarchical syllable-phoneme structure with corresponding speech rates or linguistic hierarchies (theta for syllable and gamma for phoneme). Yet, whether such a mechanism is generalizable to Mandarin Chinese, a tonal language, where lexical tones are at syllable length but function as phonemic cues, is unclear.
